Name: Lead Bobber Recipe
Author: AngelOfStars
Description:
Next in the series of me adding recipes to things that don't have recipes: The Lead Bobber! 

Again, as with all of my recipes, I tried to make this as vanilla friendly as possible. 

[u]Unlock Conditions[/u]:
[spoiler] - Level 6 Fishing (it's when the bobber becomes available in Willy's shop) 
- 2 hearts with Willy (He finds you a good enough friend to hand over the family recipe) [/spoiler]

[u]Recipe[/u]: (Obviously lead does not exist in stardew so this was the best way I could figure to do it)
- 1 Coal
- 1 Iron ingot

The recipe is configurable if you want it to be more difficult! You can either go directly into the config file that generates upon launching the game with the mod, OR you can use [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] (reccomended) and edit it through the in game menu there.

Note: The letter contains translation files as well for anyone who wants to do that, if you do - provide the pastebin for it and I will add it to the mod!

[i]If you like the stuff I make, consider sending me a [url=https://ko-fi.com/lilydoesthingssometimes]ko-fi[/url]﻿ - never required of course, I do this stuff for fun, but it does make it easier to focus on making things. [/i]
